title: lycopersicon peruvianum var. dentatum
intro: Lycopersicon peruvianum var. dentatum, commonly known as a wild tomato, is a species of flowering plant in the nightshade family. It is believed to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Lycopersicon peruvianum var. dentatum include its potential to aid in wound healing, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and support cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, carotenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
